    "cbba2453: \n .;This routine is used to edit the DICTATED DATE/BY field (#10) of the\n .;PATIENT file (#393).\n .;",
    "3d6617b2: ;Call the input transform for the field.",
    "08026bf9: ;Set up variables needed for the WORD-PROCESSING field edit.",
    "3a1bc830: ;If the Date/Time field is defined, set DE(1) to the time value.",
    "8fd1c225: ;Kill the time variable used above.",
    "63076744: ;Write the field label.",
    "b35bd3ad: ;Quit if there's nothing more to do.",
    "b8a9836d: ;Output the current value of the field being edited.",
    "84452af6: ;If the data is longer than the window width, use a Scrolling mode reply.",
    "99a5b375: ;If this is a READ-ONLY field, output a message to that effect.",
    "b12fc567: ;Read the new value, branching on a timeout.",
    "ca25d69b: ;Quit if there's nothing more to do.",
    "0f0ba092: ;Increment the DO-loop quasi-subscript.",
    "c66a4333: ;Branch to the proper DO executable for the new subscript value.",
    "fc219b8a: ;If $D(DE) (the array of current field values) is defined for the field,\n;then re-display the new values, otherwise, read a new value.",
    "ba2b8d3f: ;If X is blank, go to A unless DV contains 'R' (Required) or D>0 (Required for at least D entries) ",
    "e31398bf: ;If X starts with '?', go to QS to handle user prompts",
    "9e22718d: ;If X is '@', go to Z^DIE2 which allows the user to jump out of the current INPUT template and into another",
    "123c5c3c: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' (Default Response), DV does not contain 'P' (Multiple), and the user has a DEFAULT VALUE defined, put that value into X. If DV does not contain 'D' (Suppress Default Response) or 'S' (Suppress Auditing), display the default response on the screen",
    "ba7a2548: ;Look up X in DU (\";\"-separated list). If a match is found and DIC(\"S\") (Screening Logic) is present, execute the code. If there is a match, display it unless DB(DQ) is set (no displays). If a match is not found, continue searching through the \";\"-separated entries",
    "bd22341e: ;Search through the entries in DU until a match is found. X is truncated at the `:` delimiter. If DIC(\"S\") is present, execute the code",
    "205eab82: ;If no match is found, display the remaining characters after the last `:` delimiter in DU",
    "5457aa73: ;If DV contains 'P' (Multiple), perform M^DIC (Multiple Internal Entry Point) for the entry in DU. The DIC(0) variables are set based on DV",
    "1a03536b: ;If DV does not contain 'N' (Numeric), call D to set up DQ(DQ). If X is longer than 24 characters after the decimal point, kill X and go to Z (bad data)",
    "4be839e4: ;If the 2nd piece of DV contains a comma and X contains a decimal point and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) does not contain '$' (forcecase), remove any leading 0s from X and truncate any trailing 0s if they follow a decimal point. If there is no decimal portion, convert X to numeric",
    "2cd78eb9: ;Execute DQ code",
    "8c202b77: ;Kill DIC(\"S\"), DLAYGO. If X is not null and not '^', set DG(DW)=X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,\"DIE\",DLB)=X",
    "9d650903: ;Write '??' and an audible signal. If DB(DQ) is defined, go to Z^DIE17",
    "24e6e2ad: ;Set X='?BAD'",
    "19dccfa4: ;Set DZ=X, call D and QQ^DIEQ to handle '?'-style prompts, then go to B",
    "891fd10d: ;Set up DQ array with field label, validation string, and code for X.",
    "98653814: ;Branch to appropriate DIC if DE(DQ) is undefined.",
    "d2418d68: ;If there is a re-XMIT, get out of here.",
    "f751cd17: ;Pointer to a file's .01 field.",
    "521be16a: ;Pointer to a sub-file's .01 field.",
    "1fa566c3: ;Computed MUMPS expression for set logic.",
    "204ad58e: ;Branch to EN^DDMOD if undef OR it set AND not 'S'.",
    "37c29685: ;If not an inclusive XECUTABLE HELP.",
    "514444dc: ;Executable HELP.",
    "c516cff8: ;Clean up and quit.",
    "34c7223c: ;Initialize node name and DQ counter.",
    "75898049: ;First field values for DICTATED BY field.",
    "044a4dd2: ;DU portion of validation string.",
    "399e7e10: ;Jump to field reader.",
    "5b882d2c: ;Data transport for field DICTATED BY.",
    "5686783f: ;If no dictated by provider is entered, set the status field to 'incomplete'",
    "83b83a70: ;Clear the dictated by provider field if the user enters a blank response",
    "f5a505c7: ;Exit the input template for the dictated by provider field",
    "26b42410: ;If a dictated by provider is entered, set the status field to 'dictated'",
    "a63cb288: ;Set the status of the record to 'dictated'",
    "3541c2f2: ;Exit the input template for setting the status field",
    "e8ce5e81:  .;\n .;Branching logic to exit the current input template\n .;and enter the next template DGJXA11\n .;",
    "389323f7: ;Branch to the next input template DGJXA11"
  ]
}
